limits: Decoder-only activation checkpointing. No inference-quality, NPU-memory or full-resolution gradient claim from CPU tests.
Context must enclose both forward and backward under unchanged decoder math/RoPE.

Do not wrap the entire H3 backward with Ascend-native VAE RoPE: DiT recomputation requires eager RoPE. A future full-path integration needs distinct per-recompute context_fn. This helper has no context_fn implementation.
Shared/nested enabled scopes on any of the same blocks are rejected. Disabled mode is a no-op.
Output gradient guards persist with the graph after exit intentionally; backward outside scope raises even if no recomputation would be needed.
Parameter/buffer state, requires_grad, model training mode and class forward functions are not changed. Instance forward attribute presence and original identity are restored.
